$comment: What's machine-enforced vs. convention-only. Category keys match token-catalog.json's real keys exactly.
resolutionOrder: theme-mode override (light default / dark-scope for footer+persona-card)
permitted local override (none currently defined — see overrides below)

enforcement.color: enforced — semantic_validate.py rejects a raw hex value in a PageSpec's content fields; only semantic role ids are accepted
enforcement.fontSize: enforced — only the 8 step ids are accepted
enforcement.spacing: enforced — only catalog spacing ids are accepted
enforcement.motion: enforced — motion.pattern must be one of tokens/00-foundation/motion.json's siteWideInventory ids; additionalProperties: false on the motion object closes it to reducedMotionFallback + pattern + trigger only

overrides.$comment: Per-instance style/token-override mechanism at the PageSpec level. This design-repo's schema.pagespec.schema.json does NOT define a per-node style-override field — styling is fully owned by each section/component contract, not by a generated instance. This is a real gap relative to a more permissive design-repo shape, documented here per MASTER-GUIDE.md §3.21 rather than inventing a field just to have something to validate.
overrides.rawValueRestrictions: not applicable — no raw-value override field exists in this schema to restrict
